name: regression_ssr_roughness_40
scene: Two thin red glowing bars (emissive 4, 0, 0; 0.06 thick, 2.4 long, along x) over a white metal floor (roughness 0.4): one 0.25 up from x -2.6 to -0.2, one 1.2 up from x 0.2 to 2.6; nothing lit, exposure -5, screen-space reflections at 1.0, fourth frame; camera at (0, 2, 6) looking at (0, 0.5, 0); 128x128, 4x multisampling, no tonemapping.
reason: Reflection cone: the blur follows roughness and each ray's hit distance, so the low bar's contact reflection stays sharp while the high bar's blurs; rays that miss take their nearest neighbours' cone instead of the coarsest level, so the wide halo around the contact reflection is gone.
